stories.title: Vercel rolls out new protection against stolen session cookie attacks
stories.summary: Vercel is gradually rolling out Device Bound Session Credentials (DBSC) on its platform as a key defense against information stealer malware.

stories.title: Zyxel fixes zero-day exploited to hack nearly 1,000 network switches
stories.summary: Zyxel has patched a zero-day vulnerability in its GS1900 series network switches that hackers exploited to compromise nearly 1,000 devices worldwide and steal configuration files and credentials.

stories.title: Quoting Paul Ford
stories.summary: The web browser is very, very, very powerful software for applications, and the cost of accessing that power is going down seemingly every day . — Paul Ford , The Web Is More Than Enough Tags: browsers , paul-ford , web-development

stories.title: Setting a new standard for responsible AI infrastructure
stories.summary: OpenAI introduces its National Community Compact and Compute Campus Policy Blueprint to protect local resources, create jobs, and guide responsible AI infrastructure development.

stories.title: Paraguay's president resigns amid banking scandal
stories.summary: Protests roiled the South American nation after a bank linked to President Santiago Penã blocked millions of people from accessing their money. The central bank took control of Uena Bank on Tuesday, citing a severe capital shortfall.

stories.title: Hundreds of thousands rally across France to demand higher wages and school funding
stories.summary: The Interior Ministry estimated that 600,000 people demonstrated, while labor unions claimed a figure of 1.6 million.

stories.title: British comedian Russell Brand found guilty of rape, sexual assault
stories.summary: A London jury on Thursday convicted British comedian and actor Russell Brand of one count of rape and three counts of sexual assault.

stories.title: Borges thrashes Buse to become first lucky loser in Paris quarter-finals
stories.summary: Nuno Borges dismantled Ignacio Buse 6-0, 6-2 on Thursday to become the first lucky loser ever to reach the quarter-finals at the Paris Masters 1000.

stories.title: WTA takes 'full responsibility' after Pegula 'diva' comment live-streamed
stories.summary: The WTA says it takes "full responsibility" after private comments Jessica Pegula made to her coach about Mirra Andreeva were live-streamed by a courtside microphone.

entries.title: The leak didn't move the date
entries.body: Rockstar ran its Netflix Extended Look on 27 August as planned, and 19 November still stands. Take-Two, meanwhile, has served DMCA subpoenas on Microsoft, Discord, X and Google chasing the handle CyberLeek.

entries.title: Someone is counter-programming launch day
entries.body: Devolver Digital has a mystery game dated 19 November. Pre-orders have been open since June: Standard $79.99, Ultimate $99.99, no special edition.
